user.title: Republish a HomeKit accessory
user.description: IP address of a HomeKit accessory that only answers direct mDNS queries (for example a Hunter SIMPLEconnect fan). Give it a fixed IP (DHCP reservation).

error.no_answer: The accessory did not answer a HomeKit (_hap._tcp) mDNS query.
